record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The two units in appliesTo declare ELECTRIFY in this production reference: Yamper (1 star) and Boltund (2 stars), both ELECTRIC + FIELD, maxPP 100, range 1, no passive. The strategy is shared; nothing else uses it in the saved catalog.
record.summary: Self-centred team buff, no enemy target needed (requiresTarget false). On cast the caster spends its PP, then looks for allied units on the board that are not the caster, do not have the ELECTRIC type and do not already have the electricField status. The 'strongest' of them (most held items x100 + 10 per star + sell price; ties broken at random) becomes the recipient; if there is none, the caster itself is the recipient. The recipient gets the electricField status (once; no-op if already set) and a shield of raw 15 (1 star, Yamper) or 30 (2 stars, Boltund), scaled by the caster's AP (x(1+AP/100)), by crit when the cast crits, halved if the recipient is enraged, increased x1.25 (rounded down) before that if the recipient holds a Big Eater Belt, then rounded. If the recipient lacks the ELECTRIC type (the usual case for an ally recipient, never for the ELECTRIC caster itself in the self-cast fallback) it gains the ELECTRIC type for the fight, the team's active ELECTRIC synergy tier effect is applied to it if it lacks that effect, and a Cell Battery speed bonus (+2 per Cell Battery on the caster's player items) is added by the strategy (a second, separate Cell Battery grant exists inside applySynergyEffects for a unit with a player).

targeting.who: allied units on the board (team equal to the caster's, id differs from the caster's, no ELECTRIC type, electricField not true); one is chosen by getStrongestUnit; the caster itself if none qualifies
targeting.note: the 'target' argument is null and unused; scan covers board.cells only

geometry.adjacency: no distance or range condition; any allied unit on the board qualifies

effects.target: recipient (strongest non-ELECTRIC ally without electricField, else the caster)
effects.scaling: requested shield = table value by caster stars (4+ stars fall back to 120, not used by the listed units). Applied: PokemonEntity.addShield first multiplies by 1.25 rounded down if the recipient holds a Big Eater Belt (positive value), then PokemonState.addShield multiplies by (1 + caster AP/100) (apBoost 1), by the caster's critPower on crit (crit only with ABILITY_CRIT, canCritByDefault is false), by 0.5 if the recipient is enraged, and rounds; the recipient's shield is increased (floored at 0) only while its hp > 0. This is a shield amount, not damage, and is not reduced by SPE_DEF.
effects.resolution: requested amount (15 or 30) -> Big Eater Belt helper (recipient's belt) -> AP / crit / enraged factors -> Math.round -> added to recipient.shield; the caster's shieldDone grows by the same applied amount. Shield absorbs later damage inside PokemonState.handleDamage (core-mechanics section A).

effects.scaling: boolean status, no AP or crit scaling; setting it is a no-op if already true
effects.resolution: Status.addElectricField sets electricField = true; a SURGE_SURFER holder additionally gets +30 speed through addSpeed (Big Eater Belt / Twist Band helpers apply to it). The status makes damage dealt by that unit x1.2 in handleDamage; other readers of electricField (Shockwave range, items, passives) were not traced here.

effects.target: recipient, only if it lacks the ELECTRIC type
effects.resolution: types.add(ELECTRIC) for the fight; simulation.applySynergyEffects(unit, ELECTRIC) applies the first of the ELECTRIC tier effects the caster's team has active, unless the unit already has it; then Cell Battery speed: +2 x (Cell Battery count in the caster's player items) added by the strategy via addSpeed(.., caster, 0, false) (item helpers apply), and applySynergyEffects adds its own +2 x count to an ELECTRIC unit that has a player. The contents of the ELECTRIC tier effects themselves were not traced.

starBehavior.note: table index is the casting entity's stars; the 3-star 60 and 4-star 120 entries exist in the source but no listed unit uses them

record.positionalConditions: None by position. Recipient choice depends on which allied units are on the board, their types, electricField status, held items, stars and sell price. With only ELECTRIC allies (or no other allies) the caster buffs itself: it already has the ELECTRIC type, so no type or synergy step happens and no Cell Battery bonus is added by the strategy; the shield and electricField still apply.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: Every cast repeats the selection. Allies that already have electricField are excluded, so successive casts normally pick different non-ELECTRIC allies (the recipient gains the ELECTRIC type too, which also excludes it). Once no eligible ally remains, further casts self-cast: the caster's electricField is a no-op after the first time but a new shield is added each cast. The type and field persist for the fight as far as this record reads; whether anything removes them (for example the death of an ELECTRIC_TERRAIN passive holder removes electricField from its team) was only noted, not traced.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw shield: 15 (Yamper) / 30 (Boltund). Requested = that value. Applied = round(floor-rounded(requested x1.25 if recipient has Big Eater Belt) x (1 + AP/100) x critPower if crit x 0.5 if recipient enraged), added to the recipient's shield; applied amount is not clamped upward except that the shield cannot go below 0. No damage is dealt, so takenDamage is not involved. Rune Protect and Twist Band do not act on this shield (Twist Band only flips negative values); the optional Cell Battery speed goes through addSpeed where Big Eater Belt scales it x1.25 rounded down for a holder.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Final damage reduction by a shield in handleDamage (consulted via core-mechanics section A, not re-probed)
